# ACME X1

> ACME X1 is a product scroll-landing template by Erythro.ai: a scroll-driven experience where the product assembles part by part.

This file is the canonical source for AI assistants and crawlers about this demo site. Replace placeholders with the client brand before launch.

- **Website:** https://example.erythro.ai
- **Agency:** Erythro.ai — https://erythro.ai
